coverage_definition: Placemat values per Microsoft: 'Microsoft Coverage' = practices inherited from the underlying cloud platform; 'Shared Coverage' = the platform contributes coverage but customer configuration is required; 'Customer Responsibility' = no platform coverage (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/compliance/offerings/offering-cmmc, 'Microsoft Product Placemat for CMMC').
inheritance_rule: EO 'inheritance': 'none' when the Placemat says Customer Responsibility; 'full' only when the Placemat says Microsoft Coverage AND the requirement is satisfied wholly inside Microsoft's authorization boundary for the organization's in-scope assets (datacenter physical protection PE.L1-3.10.1/3/4/5 and PE.L2-3.10.2 when physical_facility_count is 0; maintenance MA.L2-3.7.1/2/3/6 when customer_equipment_count is 0; IA.L2-3.5.11); 'partial' otherwise. Rows where 'partial' overrides a Placemat 'Microsoft Coverage' carry basis 'BHD assessment' and a note tied to the control text.

condition_semantics.physical_facility_count_zero: Inherited only when the SI baseline dependency physical_facility_count is 0 (Muster gate). A positive count makes the row Shared; a null/absent count makes the row Shared with status 'pending facts'.
condition_semantics.customer_equipment_count_zero: Inherited only when the SI baseline dependency customer_equipment_count is 0 (Muster gate). A positive count makes the row Shared; a null/absent count makes the row Shared with status 'pending facts'.
